messages:
Mira: Heads-up — noticed ~200 tenants with a preview-credit spike right after last night's deploy. looks like an ingest header flip (route attr missing) :eyes:
Alex: ugh. same. dashboards show lots of "unknown_route" attribution. rolling window for invoice preview blew up.
Tariq: did anyone change the edge proxy header name? I remember a PR to rename X-Route-Id -> X-Routing recently.
Mira: yeah that PR landed in canary but supposed to be behind flags. seems some shards saw it live.
Alex: quick diff from the proxy logs shows requests with headers: 
```
X-Routing: tenant-123
X-Route-Id: tenant-456
```
Mira: ingest service normalizes to route_id via header precedence: X-Route-Id > X-Routing currently. if precedence flipped, we get dup attribution.
Tariq: ok two things: 1) fallback compatibility in ingest to accept both and prefer non-empty. 2) add a canary-only metric for "header-variants" so console can show active header distribution.
Mira: +1 for the metric. the current console query is opaque; ops can't tell which header version caused the spike.
DashOps: we can add a short card in the invoice preview that shows header-provenance (percent by header) using the new metric — would help customer support immediately.
Alex: implementation sketch in ingest:
```python
def extract_route(headers):
    return headers.get('X-Route-Id') or headers.get('X-Routing') or 'unknown_route'
```
Mira: small caveat: we need to stamp a "route_origin" tag on events (e.g., "legacy-header", "new-header") so downstream dedupe + billing uses stable provenance. otherwise ledger reconciliation will be painful.
Tariq: agree. also, add a short TTL on preview credits for 24h for unknown_route to avoid permanent invoice drift while we fix.
Alex: does that mean modifying the preview pipeline TTL window? we should be careful not to throw out valid consumption. maybe just flag them as "provisional" and exclude from final invoice until we reconcile.
Mira: provisional tag is safer. Ops can then run a recon job to reassign once header mapping is fixed.
ingest-bot: alert triggered: route-tagging-anomaly (7065432122) — 213 events with missing route_resolution_id in last 10m.
Alex: thanks bot. ok timeline: I'll patch ingest to emit route_origin + header_variant metric, and set provisional=true for unknown_route flows. estimate 2-3hrs.
Tariq: I can push a tiny rollback toggle in the proxy to restore old header precedence while we monitor. low-risk flag rollout.
DashOps: I'll add a temporary dashboard card: header-variant %, provisional-credit-count, and a quick link to run a recon playbook.
Mira: labeling this a priority P2 — billing impact but non-critical; we should notify SRE and CS.
Alex: pinging @SRE for visibility.
Tariq: deploy plan: canary proxy toggle -> ingest feature flag -> dashboard live -> recon job. rollback plan: toggle off proxy, run dedupe check.
Mira: also add an alert to the console that fires if provisional credits exceed 0.5% of daily token volume for a tenant. helps catch regressions quickly.
DashOps: ack, will add the alert threshold and an automated slack webhook to this channel.
Mira: thanks everyone. Alex/Tariq coordinate on PRs, post links here when ready.
Alex: will do. opening PRs now.
Tariq: starting the proxy toggle canary in us-west-2 -> will watch header-variant metric.
Mira: filing a quick postmortem checklist after we stabilize (notes + timeline + lessons about flagging header renames).
Alex: +1. also we should add a unit test for header-precedence to avoid this in the future.
Mira: nice. closing the loop once recon job runs. :white_check_mark:
